description_sq:
Apartament luksoz ne shitje tek Selvia!!
I pozicionuar ne nje nga zonat me elitare te Tiranes, te Vila Gold, Rruga e Dibres, nje vendndodhje qe ofron komoditet, siguri dhe akses shume te shpejt me qendren e qytetit.
Nje apartament unik, lukzos, i investuar me standarde te larta, ku eleganca klasike dhe hapesira e detajet e tjera krijojne nje ambient te konceptuar per nje stil jetese eksluziv.
Organizohet:
- Super sallon i madh me hapesire te bollshme dhe oxhak ne qender
- Kuzhine e vecuar, moderne dhe funksionale
- 3 dhoma gjumi te medha, secila me tualetin privat
- Garderobe
- Banje luksoze me vaske dhe materiale premium
- 4 ballkone me pamje fantastike te kryeqytetit
Interiori eshte i realizuar me:
- Driate dopio xham
- Parket cilesore
- Punime dekorative klasike ne mure
- Ndricim i integruar
- Grila elektrike
- Mobilim dhe materiale te standadit te larte
Ofrohen dhe 2 poste parkimi me cmim ekstra.
Per nje vizite nga afer na kontaktoni!
description_en: Luxury apartment for sale in Selvia!! Positioned in one of the most elite areas of Tirana, at Vila Gold, Rruga e Dibre, a location that offers convenience, security and very quick access to the city center. A unique, luxurious apartment, invested with high standards, where classic elegance and space and other details create an environment designed for an exclusive lifestyle. Organized: - Super large living room with ample space and fireplace in the center - Separate, modern and functional kitchen - 3 large bedrooms, each with private toilet - Wardrobe - Luxury bathroom with bathtub and premium materials - 4 balconies with a fantastic view of the capital The interior is made with: - Double glazing - Quality parquet - Classic decorative works on the walls - Integrated lighting - Electric shutters - Furniture and materials of high standard. 2 parking spaces are also available at an extra cost. For a visit from nearby, contact us!
